title: A project's record states its purpose, read first
situation: A fresh architect documenting cratylus from its record could not say what cratylus is for: each context states its own subject, and the product's purpose lived only in a document outside the record.
decision: A project's record holds the project's purpose: what the project is for, in plain words, recorded and changed like a context's description. Every overview shows it first, so a fresh session meets the purpose before the parts.
consequences: Cratylus records its own purpose once the record can hold it.
